title: New Materials are CHEAPER AND NOT AS good as old pillow by this brand....WASTE of $ - LOW QUALITY NOW
text:
New Materials are CHEAPER AND NOT AS good as old pillow by this brand....WASTE of $ - LOW QUALITY NOW. Don't WASTE your money on this. This used to be a good brand but now hey switched to synthetic FLAMMABLE fabric and clay beads which are hard as rock on neck. Seek a pillow with safe materials like cotton and flax seed. The polyestor and nylon covers like this are highly flammable which is why they start fires in microwave.
This is ok for a week or two, them the Clay Beads start breaking down and becomes little poky sharp things which push tgrough the synthetic cover amd are very uncomfortable, not soft. These Clay things are not the best. The old cotton velour covers were better and the old stufing of flax seeds etc was much better and lasted longer. These new ones are not worth this price at all. Too bad Earth Therapeutics decided to get rid of the old heat pillow and make a new version with cheaper worse materials. Not surprised. Seems all the companies now are switching to cheap materials so they can break down fast and we have to keep replacing more often. So sad the American dream is dying out. Feels like a 3rd world country now. Can't find any quality procucts lately....

product_metadata.title: Anti-Stress Microwavable Neck Pillow
features: Features a soothing chamomile and lavender scent.
description: Whether you need to relieve muscle tension with heat or reduce swelling with cold, this comfortable u-shaped pillow for your neck is the solution. Microwave it for a warm session, or freeze it to apply cool pressure to a problem area.
